name: Predator's Syndrome
source:
After a car accident, you seem to have landed in a weird town, where most of the people have strange names but...they seem welcoming at least!

Maybe things won't be so bad!

[From [url=https://xxxdream-sodaxxx.itch.io/predators-syndrome-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场车祸后，你似乎来到了一个奇怪的小镇，那里的大多数人都有着奇怪的名字，但……他们至少看起来很热情！

也许事情不会那么糟糕！

[来自[url=https://xxxdream-sodaxxx.itch.io/predators-syndrome-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
